title: Adder circuit recognizes binary addition
statement: Let $a$, $b$, and $c$ be finite Boolean lists of equal length. The adder circuit on the concatenated input $a,b,c$ outputs true if and only if the integer represented by $c$ in binary equals the sum of the integers represented by $a$ and $b$ in binary.
hypotheses_covered: The lengths of $a$ and $c$ are equal
The lengths of $b$ and $c$ are equal
